gate.subtitle: Your server, your saves.
gate.forgot: Did you forget it? In that case:
gate.token_hint: The same token the app and the CLI use. It is exchanged for a session and never stored in this browser.
account.password_hint: At least 8 characters. Any other browser session is signed out; your devices keep syncing.
account.wrong_current: That is not your current password.
saves.title: Saves
saves.caption: Open one to see every version the server holds, the trash included. Downloads are compressed .tar.zst archives of the whole save.
saves.download_title: A .tar.zst with the whole version, compressed — it lands smaller than the size shown.
saves.empty: This account has no saves yet.
saves.delete_body: It goes to the trash and can be recovered for {days} days. After that the server deletes it for good.
saves.limits_caption: How many versions of each save the server keeps. Empty means no limit.
saves.limits_body: {n} versions are over the limit and go to the trash. They can be recovered for {days} days.
saves.limits_done_pruned: Limits updated. {n} versions moved to the trash.
devices.title: Devices
devices.caption: Every machine that has signed in with this account.
devices.remove_body: {name} disappears from the list. Nothing is deleted, and it comes back the next time that machine syncs.
activity.title: Activity
activity.caption: What the server recorded: versions created, restored, deleted and pruned.
activity.new_bytes_title: Bytes that were not already stored
server.logical_sub: What every version weighs added up
server.orphans_sub: No longer referenced; the hourly sweep collects them
server.database_sub: Includes the write-ahead log · {logs} client log lines
server.pruning_off_sub: Nothing is thinned; only your version limits apply
server.max_upload_sub: A save over this is refused
users.title: Users
users.caption: Accounts, quotas and roles. Everything hoard-admin does, without a shell on the server.
users.promote_body: {user} will see this section and be able to change quotas, roles and tokens for everyone.
users.demote_body: {user} keeps their saves but loses access to this section.
users.tokens_caption: A revoked token stops working on the next request. Revoked ones are not listed.
users.revoke_body_session: The browser session of {user} is closed on its next request.
users.revoke_body_device: {user} stops syncing on {device} until a new token is issued.
users.rename_hint: Saves and devices follow the account, not the name. Only hoard-admin commands take the new one.
users.password_sessions: Closes their open browser sessions. Their PCs keep syncing.
users.delete_hint: Deletes the account and every save it holds: {size} across {versions} versions. This cannot be undone.
users.token_hint: One token per PC, so you can revoke one without touching the rest.
users.token_once: For {user}. It is shown once — copy it now, or create another later.
users.token_select: Could not copy. The token is selected — press Ctrl+C.
error.bad_username: Letters, digits, dash, underscore and dot only.
error.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete the account you are signed in as.
error.reserved_device_name: That name is reserved for browser sessions.
logs.title: Client logs
logs.caption: What the apps report to this server. Kept for as long as retention allows.
error.internal: The server hit an error. Check its log.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {n} s.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
error.last_admin: This is the last admin. Promote someone else first.
error.bad_quota: Enter a quota of zero or more.
error.session_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
